<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Master Roshi''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kame House|Kame House]] on the coast of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Krillin|Krillin]]. He teaches the basics, from Jump and Meditation to the Kamehameha, and gives out weighted Turtle Shells. He only trains Good-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
Roshi lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Kame House|Kame House]], which generates once per world on an ocean coast. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 1 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Kame House#Finding it|Kame House]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment == <!--T:9-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:10-->
Roshi needs an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''61 or higher''' (Good). Below that he still talks to you, but his '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests stay locked. His Weighted Gear service stays open.
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques == <!--T:11-->
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:12-->
* '''Skills:''' Jump, [[Special:MyLanguage/Meditation|Meditation]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]]
* '''Ki attack:''' Kamehameha
* '''Evasion technique:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Afterimage|Afterimage]]
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:13-->
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
</translate>

<translate>
== Services == <!--T:14-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:15-->
'''Weighted Gear''': type the weight you want and Roshi gives you a '''Turtle Shell''' of that weight (up to 100,000 kg by default). You can ask once per conversation; talk to him again for more. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|Weights]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:16-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:17-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 6, ''The Turtle Hermit'': find Kame House and talk to Master Roshi.
* Classic Saga quest 7, ''Milk Delivery Training'': give Master Roshi 3 Milk Buckets.
* Classic Saga quest 30, ''Heavy Shell Training'': give Master Roshi 1 Scute.
</translate>
